relations: As the raised hand lowers to her side, her torso rotates so her back faces the camera more squarely.
Her turning body swings the ponytail across her shoulders while the mirror reflects her front and collar scarf.
Settling into a wide stance with one foot pointed, the mirror shows an arm reaching horizontally despite lowered arms.
The reflected arm lifts into a full upward reach as she holds the raised-arm line with the pointed foot extended.
caption: The video captures a ponytailed woman in a short black dress with a sheer asymmetric hem, black leg-warmers and heeled shoes, standing in a white studio whose mirror wall reflects her throughout. The fixed camera shows her holding an angled pose, one arm bent and raised beside her head, the other extended back and down. After slight shifts of the raised hand, it lowers to shoulder height and drops to her side. Her torso turns so her back faces the camera more squarely, her ponytail swinging across her shoulders. With arms down she turns further, the reflection showing her front and the scarf at her collar. She settles into a wide stance, weight on one leg as the other foot points. The mirror reveals an arm reaching horizontally even as her arms appear lowered from behind. Then that arm lifts into a fully extended upward reach toward the ceiling, and she holds this raised-arm line with the pointed foot extended.
